channel.title: X-Autopilot
channel.description: Auto-update feed for X-Autopilot Mac app

item.title: v1.0.12
item.description:
• The DM (direct message) feature has been completely removed. X's API and UI have made automated DM sending the #1 trigger for account warnings and rate-limit penalties — the cost-to-benefit was upside-down for every buyer. The agent now focuses on what works without DM risk: replies, tweets, threads, likes, follows, unfollows, and welcome-via-likes for new followers.
  • What got deleted: the entire actions/dm.py module, all DM generators (generate_dm_opener, generate_dm_welcome, generate_dm_reply), the DM session in the afternoon scheduler, the DM follow-up flagging during replies, and all DM-related dashboard UI (Daily DMs input, per-tier "DM after engagement" toggles, "DM from hashtag/home" toggles, "Never DM verified accounts" safety toggle, the DMs stat box).
  • Welcome flow for new followers preserved — but silent. When you gain a follower, the agent still likes 3-4 of their posts as a friendly nod. It just doesn't send a "thanks for the follow!" DM (which X increasingly treats as spam regardless of voice quality).
  • Config keys removed: engagement.daily_dms, per-tier dm_after_engagement / dm_delay_min_minutes / dm_delay_max_minutes, discovery.dm_from_hashtags, discovery.dm_from_home_feed, safety.never_dm_verified_accounts. Existing keys in your config.yaml are ignored and harmless — leave them or remove on next edit.
  • The legacy dm_conversations SQLite table is preserved (CREATE IF NOT EXISTS) so any historical data on existing installs is not lost. No code writes to it anymore. Drop it manually if you want a clean DB.

item.title: v1.0.11
item.description:
• Live X-bio context. The agent now scrapes your own profile (bio, pinned tweet, follower count) once per startup (24h cache) and injects it into every LLM prompt. Result: replies and tweets stop drifting away from your CURRENT positioning — the model knows what your bio says you do, and won't invent contradictory credentials. Cached at data/self_bio.json.
  • Proactive promo discovery. New reply source promo_discovery (default 10% of session budget). Instead of waiting for product keywords to surface randomly in the home feed, the agent actively searches X for tweets matching each promotion's trigger_keywords with a min_faves filter — so product mentions land on visible, relevant conversations. Still capped by promotions.product_reply_max_per_day. Set discovery.promo_discovery_session_share: 0.0 to disable.
  • Auto-suggest watchlist. Once per day (after 9am, only when watchlist has <10 entries), the agent calls the same LLM-driven suggester as the dashboard's ✨ Suggest button and adds up to 2 new accounts at a long 4hr interval. Voice profile required. Conservative caps + long interval mean even occasional LLM hallucinations cause minimal noise — review/edit suggestions in the Discovery → Watchlist panel.
  • Auto-suggested accounts are logged on add so you can spot them in the dashboard log; they default to a 240-min check interval (vs. user-added 60-min) so they earn their place before consuming budget.

item.title: v1.0.10
item.description:
• You can now explicitly allocate session reply budget across discovery sources. 6 new config knobs in discovery: target_session_share, hashtag_session_share, home_session_share, explore_session_share, inspiration_session_share, high_engagement_session_share. Each is a float 0.0-1.0 — set to 0 to disable a source entirely. Example: 50% hashtags + 30% home + 10% targets + 10% explore + 0% inspiration + 0% high-engagement.
  • The bandit still picks ORDER between active sources but no longer overrides allocation — your per-source shares are honored as hard budget caps.
  • Backwards compatible: if a share isn't configured, falls back to legacy behavior (40% inspiration, ~10% explore, ~10% high-engagement, hashtag/home capped by max_*_replies_per_session).

item.title: v1.0.9
item.description:
• CRITICAL: Fixes "Session error — retrying soon" forever loop with 0 actions across the board. v1.0.0 through v1.0.8 all shipped with a packaging bug — the bundled .app was missing the entire actions/ package (reply.py, follow.py, like.py, dm.py, tweet.py, notifications.py). Every session attempt threw ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'actions.reply', the agent caught it as a session error, slept 60s, and retried — endlessly. Symptom: dashboard stats stuck at 0 tweets / 0 replies / 0 follows / 0 likes / 0 DMs across the entire day. Fix: PyInstaller spec now uses collect_submodules for actions/, ai/, agent/, and dashboard/ packages so every module the agent lazily imports is bundled. v1.0.9 actually works.
  • If you were on v1.0.0–v1.0.8 with all-zero stats: install v1.0.9 — the agent will finally start engaging. Manual recovery from a failed install: open Finder → Applications → double-click X-Autopilot.app.

item.title: v1.0.8
item.description:
• Critical fix: auto-update no longer leaves the app dead. v1.0.0 through v1.0.7 had a bug where clicking Install Now would quit the app but never relaunch it (Launch Services bundle cache wasn't refreshed after the swap, and `open -a path` had ambiguous behavior). Symptom: app quits, dashboard tab dies, dock icon disappears. v1.0.8 uses a detached helper script that waits for the parent to die, refreshes the LS cache via lsregister, and launches by path with no -a flag. If you got hit by this on a previous version: open Finder → Applications → double-click X-Autopilot.app to recover. The new bundle is on disk; the OS just didn't relaunch it. After this manual fix, v1.0.8's installer will work for all future updates.
  • One-click "Generate from voice profile" in Settings, above Content Topics. Single LLM call returns niche-appropriate defaults for all 6 content fields (never-say phrases, content topics, voice pillars, signature angles, proof bank, weekly direction). Modal preview with per-field tick + APPEND/OVERWRITE choice. Cost: ~$0.005 on your configured LLM.
  • Auto-post toggle on the Approval Queue page itself — same toggle that was buried in Settings → Posting, now prominent at the top of the queue.
  • Thread auto-approve fixed. Single tweets honored require_approval=false from v1.0.4 but threads always went to manual approval. Now threads auto-approve all parts when auto-post is on.
  • Voice Lab editor copy: "Changes take effect immediately, no agent restart needed."

item.title: v1.0.7
item.description:
• Gemini is now clearly marked as the free option. The provider selector in Settings → API Keys now shows "FREE — no card needed, ~250 replies/day on free tier" next to Gemini, with a green RECOMMENDED badge. Anthropic and OpenAI hints clarify the trial-credit reality so first-time buyers don't accidentally burn $5 in a day.
  • "⚠ HIGH FAIL" badge is now clickable. Hover shows the tooltip ("follow: 47% fail rate (12 samples) — common cause: stale targets that no longer exist"). Click → confirmation dialog → clears the rolling stats for the elevated endpoint(s). Badge disappears instantly after clear.
  • Cleaner messaging: the badge now reads "⚠ HIGH FAIL: FOLLOW (click to clear)" so the action is discoverable.

item.title: v1.0.6
item.description:
• "✨ Suggest from my niche" buttons in Discovery → Hashtags and Discovery → Watchlist. Click → your configured LLM reads your voice profile + niche → returns 8-15 hashtags or 10-15 X accounts active in your space → tick the ones you want → ADD. No more empty-list paralysis after the v1.0.5 cleanup. Cost: ~$0.001-0.005 per click on your own LLM key.
  • Inspiration page now niche-filtered. The agent's /i/jf/creators/inspiration/top_posts scan was surfacing globally-trending posts (cricket scores, celebrity drama) that had nothing to do with your niche. Now each candidate is scored 0.0-1.0 against your voice profile via a tiny cached LLM call; off-topic tweets are dropped before they reach the reply pipeline. Falls back gracefully to "no filtering" if no voice profile is set.
  • Watchlist suggestions show a one-line "why" for each suggested account so you can decide quickly + a "open profile" link to verify the handle exists before adding (LLMs occasionally hallucinate handles).

item.title: v1.0.4
item.description:
• New "Generate Voice Profile" tool in the Voice Lab tab. Paste 50-100 of your recent tweets → click COPY PROMPT → paste into Claude.ai or ChatGPT → paste the structured profile back → SAVE. Done. Every reply and tweet from that point on is anchored to YOUR actual voice instead of generic patterns.
  • Why this matters: the #1 complaint after v1.0.1 was "replies feel generic / off-niche". The root cause is users don't know how to articulate their own voice. The 3000-character extraction prompt gets the LLM to produce an extremely specific profile (identity, niche, tone, linguistic patterns, hook patterns, reference tweets, do/don't rules) — far better than what most users would write themselves.
  • Doesn't burn your in-app API budget — runs externally on Claude.ai or ChatGPT (your choice). One-time onboarding step.
  • The prompt template lives in agent/voice_template.py (version-controlled with the agent) so future tweaks ship via auto-update.
